name: Broken Wheel Campground
evidence: satellite at 38.99895,-80.45570: fully canopy-blind - the campground reads only as a small clearing with a store building and scattered campers off Skin Creek Rd, and no open water is visible anywhere on the property; the operator advertises a stocked catch-and-release fishing pond but publishes no per-site map, so nothing confirms RV pads at water -> default down.

name: Eagle's Nest Campground
evidence: satellite at 39.53600,-78.74880 (zoom to 300 m frame): three rows of RVs on open valley-bottom grass; Patterson Creek runs along the east edge roughly 20-40 m from the easternmost row but behind a continuous wooded riparian strip, so there is a real vegetated screen and no sightline from any pad -> not waterfront, not riverview.

name: Gheny Nook Campground
evidence: satellite at 37.93566,-80.17022, LEAF-OFF imagery (decisive here): ~60-80 travel trailers on two gravel lanes down a wooded hollow, and no open water of any kind is visible - no pond surface and no creek channel - despite bare canopy; the Greenbrier CVB listing's 'fresh mountain creek' and fishing ponds are unconfirmed and no per-site map exists -> default down.

name: Hidden Hollow RV Park
evidence: satellite at 39.89531,-80.79507: the pads sit in a wooded hollow below the Moundsville Country Club with the golf course fairways and a rail line between them and the Ohio River, which is roughly 450-700 m west and not visible from any pad; the operator's 'borders Ohio River Islands NWR (Captina Island)' is a property-line claim, not shoreline access -> not waterfront.
